topic: 食品码垛工位观察（混合上屏）

content_blocks.content: 视频标题: 食品码垛工位观察（混合上屏） 全片副标题: 袋装与箱装同线码垛的现场核对要点
content_blocks.purpose: provide video title and subtitle for opening display

content_blocks.content: 7-shot breakdown with columns: 分镜, 分镜标题, 时长, 章节标签, 画面, 口播, 字幕, 上屏文字, 卡片样式
content_blocks.purpose: define timeline of video segments with visual, voice, subtitle, and on-screen text instructions

content_blocks.content: 模块二：视频分镜脚本（7 段）
content_blocks.purpose: indicate start of shot scripting section
indicate start of cover文案 section

extra_requirements: 原始文件中'上屏文字'和'卡片样式'列可能存在占位符如'（不填）'，需按规则处理为空字符串
分镜3标题为'镜头B'，非语义命名，应根据上下文重命名为有意义的标题
分镜间存在逻辑顺序：从物料进入→分类核对→动作检查→落盘确认→换型准备→全局视角→行动号召

shots.title: 来料到位是第一道关
shots.download_query: white packaged bags on conveyor belt
shots.visual_query: white packaging bags queuing on a conveyor belt, medium shot showing conveyor and guardrails
shots.voice_text: 袋装物料码垛，先看来料怎样到位，再看机械臂如何抓取和落放。
shots.subtitle: 先看来料到位，再看抓取落放
shots.card_content: 来料到位是码垛稳定的第一道关

shots.title: 袋料和箱体要分开核对
shots.download_query: packaging bags and boxed drinks on separate conveyors
shots.visual_query: packaging bags and boxed beverage cases moving on two parallel conveyors, contrast shot
shots.voice_text: 袋料和箱体的外形不同，来料朝向、抓取位置和支撑方式要分别核对。
shots.subtitle: 袋料与箱体分别核对

shots.title: 镜头B
shots.download_query: robot arm lifting and rotating package
shots.visual_query: robot arm lifting material with full view of package and gripper outline, checking clearance from conveyor guardrail
shots.voice_text: 抓具带料抬起、转向时，要检查包装与工具有没有碰到输送带护栏。
shots.subtitle: 抬升转向不碰护栏

shots.title: 落盘确认
shots.download_query: boxed drinks placed on pallet with existing layers
shots.visual_query: boxed beverage case being placed on plastic pallet with already stacked lower layer visible
shots.voice_text: 包装落到托盘以后，还要核对排列方向、垛层边缘和抓具退出的路径。
shots.subtitle: 核对方向与退出路径

shots.title: 换型准备
shots.download_query: worker checking new packaging sample at palletizing station
shots.visual_query: worker examining new packaging sample beside palletizing station, background shows finished pallet area
shots.voice_text: 换包装之前，先备好新包装样件、目标垛型和现场布局，再逐项确认要调整的抓具与路径。
shots.subtitle: 换型前先备齐三样

shots.title: 工位衔接
shots.download_query: palletizing robots operating simultaneously in workshop
shots.visual_query: workshop interior showing pickup point, conveyor line, and pallet position in one frame, multiple palletizing robots working
shots.voice_text: 把取料端、输送线和托盘位置放在一起看，更容易看清工位之间的衔接。
shots.subtitle: 整合视图看工位衔接

shots.title: 欢迎带着包装形态来试
shots.download_query: robot placing boxed drinks on pallet revealing finished pallet area
shots.visual_query: robot arm placing boxed beverage case onto pallet, camera pulls back to reveal completed pallet storage area
shots.voice_text: 动态画面只能帮着理解工位配置，破包、滑移和满垛稳定性还是要在现场试。
shots.subtitle: 稳定性要在现场试
shots.card_content: 带上你的包装形态和目标垛型，一起把这条线试一遍
